title: Resolve Test Names to Definition IDs in Hook Events
description: Implement test name to definition ID resolution in resolveEventIDs. Currently test names in tests/succeeded/failed arrays are left as raw strings. They should be resolved to definition IDs (like search definition reads pattern) when test file paths are available in the event context.
summary: Implemented test name to definition ID resolution in hook events. Changes: (1) Added Files field to HookResultAgentToolTestStarting and HookResultAgentToolTestEnded structs. (2) Refactored extractTestStartingFromInput to separate files from test names. (3) Refactored extractTestEndedFromInput to extract files from tool_input. (4) Updated dispatchHook to pass files to both test result types. (5) Added resolveTestNamesToDefinitionIDs function that parses definitions from test files and matches by name (case-insensitive). (6) Added resolveTestItems helper for two-pass resolution (files→fileIDs, names→definitionIDs). (7) Updated resolveEventIDs to resolve files field and use file context for tests/succeeded/failed arrays. (8) Added comprehensive tests covering all new functionality.
